programme.desc:
Discover the simple 15-minute Bible practice that transforms how you think pray and walk with God a daily rhythm of reading through the Psalms and Proverbs that engrafts Gods Word into your soul In this Bible study Lance Wallnau breaks down a system hes used for decades reading five Psalms and one Proverb a day cycling through both books 12 times a year to build devotion and wisdom into your daily life
